messages:
Aisha (New Hire): Hi all! Two quick onboarding bumps I'm hoping someone can point me to:
- My start date was 2024-03-20 but my benefits confirmation email says coverage starts 2024-04-01. Is that normal? Should I expect any gap?
- I need to add my partner to medical. What's the deadline for dependents and what docs are required?
- Also I mailed in a relocation receipt last week. How long does approvals usually take?

Priya (People Ops): Welcome, Aisha! :wave: Short answers:
- Coverage: standard policy is first of the month following 30 days of employment, so 4/1 sounds right given start date. If you have urgent care between start and 4/1, ping me and we'll advise on temporary coverage options.
- Dependents: you have 30 days from your benefit eligibility date to enroll dependents. We require domestic partner affidavit or marriage certificate + proof of residency (2 docs) depending on status. @Nina can list vendor-specific upload steps.
- Relocation receipts: finance typically processes within 5-10 business days after People Ops approval. If you uploaded via the portal, include the signed relocation agreement so it doesn't stall.

Aisha (New Hire): Ok thanks. Quick follow-up 1: how do I upload partner docs? I tried the benefits portal but it errors on file type. I have a scanned PDF.

Nina (Benefits): Hey Aisha 1 — send the PDF via the benefits portal (https://benefits.redwood.com) and choose "Dependent Enrollment" then "Domestic Partner/Spouse". If the portal rejects, DM me the filename and I can trigger a manual upload with the vendor. Accepted file types: PDF, PNG, JPG, max 10MB.

Kyle (Payroll): FYI on the relocation payout: once People Ops approves, Finance issues via the next expense run; if you selected reimbursement to bank it posts in ~3 business days after approval. If you'd like it as payroll (taxed) instead, file under one-time income and we'll sync to payroll cutoff. Also check your direct deposit is set up: ADP > Myself > Bank Info.

Aisha (New Hire): I checked ADP and my bank isn't showing verified. I did the micro-deposit yesterday. Who do I follow up with if it doesn't verify?

Priya (People Ops): If micro-deposits don't verify within 48 hours, open a support ticket with Payroll via the HR portal or ping @Kyle here and include the ADP ticket number.

Aisha (New Hire): Noted. One more: holiday accrual — I start mid-March, do I get the floating day allocation this year or is it prorated?

Nina (Benefits): Floating days are prorated by FTE and start-date. For mid-quarter hires we pro-rate your allotment based on remaining calendar months. We'll calculate and post to your profile; should be visible in 24-48 hours.

Aisha (New Hire): Great, thanks everyone. I'll upload docs and follow up if ADP verification stalls.

HR Bot: Reminder: dependent enrollment deadline for employees with 2024-03-20 eligibility is 2024-04-19. Upload required documents or contact benefits within the window to avoid plan denial.

Priya (People Ops): Closing note: Aisha, if you want I can review your dependent docs before you upload to save vendor back-and-forth. Happy to help. :smile:
